text.line.m.a1.11.msg: Market night. I will talk you through the trucks once you have said hello to the raffle guest.
text.line.m.a1.11.patrol: The tow companies called it in. A patrol is rolling on you. Lose it and go home.
text.line.m.a1.11.start: X Ramos on the dispatch line. The market is full tonight and the guest of honor is drawing tickets. Say hello, then keep your eyes on the curb.
text.line.m.a1.11.talk.raffle.open: Ticket number seven thousand and one! Come over, there is a prize with your name on it, and I promise it is not a parking ticket.
text.line.m.a1.11.trucks: Three Halcyon compliance trucks just pulled out to clear the stalls. Get a car and block every one of them in before the market is gone.
text.mission.m.a1.11.fail.ride: Your car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.box_a: Box in the first compliance truck
text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.box_b: Box in the second compliance truck
text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.box_c: Box in the third compliance truck
text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.enter_ride: Grab a car at the end of the market
text.mission.m.a1.11.obj.talk_raffle: Say thanks to the guest of honor
text.mission.m.a1.11.talk.raffle.intent: Thank the guest for the raffle
text.mission.m.a1.11.talk.raffle.thanks: Thanks, the whole block loves the raffle
text.mission.m.a1.11.title: Night Market
